headings.style: Elegant, editorial, high contrast. Use italics for emphasis.

body.style: Clean, highly readable, wide tracking for caps.

intro_reveal.description: Cinematic full-screen loader. Dark espresso background. 'ÂMICI' wordmark is revealed line-by-line using GSAP, followed by a slight scale down and fade out. Includes the petal/tulip glyph.

hero.description: Kinetic Hero. A large atmospheric video/image in the background with a 40% black overlay. Big central typography 'Liberdade é estar feliz consigo mesma'. Scroll down indicator.

scalpel_scroll_section.description: The Hero Mechanic. A pinned section using GSAP ScrollTrigger. A scalpel SVG is centered. As user scrolls down, the scalpel visually 'cuts' the layout vertically, revealing new content or splitting images like a before/after reveal.

gallery.description: Bento-style or masonry grid with minimal gaps. Hovering over images reveals a subtle dark overlay with the procedure/result name. Editable via Admin.

admin_cms.description: A clean, functional dashboard accessible via /admin. Uses Shadcn-like customized components in pure JS matching the mocha brand. Forms to edit hero text, update gallery images, manage feedbacks, etc.

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis is mandatory for luxury momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.intro_timeline: GSAP timeline: 1. Split text on 'ÂMICI'. 2. Staggered reveal from bottom. 3. Hold for 1.5s. 4. Y-axis slide up of the entire intro curtain.
motion_and_interactions.scalpel_scrub: GSAP ScrollTrigger with scrub:true. Pin the container, animate the height of a mask or clip-path based on scroll progress to simulate a downward cut.
motion_and_interactions.text_reveal: Framer Motion for general scroll-into-view text elements. Use slight Y translate (20px) and opacity fade.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Dark mocha background with cream text. Hover: subtle scale and background shift to accent color.
components.cards: Minimalist. Background #161110, 1px solid #2A1E19 border. Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md) corners.
components.admin_sidebar: Left-aligned, dark espresso, thin border right. Links for: Hero Edit, Gallery, Testimonials, History, Videos.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Input structures translated to raw React/Tailwind. Background transparent, border bottom only (editorial style) or standard subtle borders in Admin.

visual_enhancers.noise: Subtle SVG film grain overlay fixed across the entire site (opacity 3-5%).
visual_enhancers.cursor: Custom dot cursor using framer-motion that expands when hovering over clickable elements or images.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px borders (#2A1E19) extensively to create an 'architectural/editorial' grid feel.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images always has a gradient or solid dark overlay to maintain WCAG AA readability. Specifically over the mocha background, text should be pure cream/beige.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Disable GSAP pinned scrub if motion sensitivity is detected.
accessibility.testing: All editable inputs in Admin and major site actions MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: You are building a pure JS/JSX project. DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx/.ts) files.
Configure Tailwind with the exact color tokens (mocha/caramel/espresso). Setup Cormorant Garamond and Manrope via Google Fonts in index.html.
Implement the 'ÂMICI' cinematic intro as a full-screen fixed overlay using GSAP that plays on first load.
Build the Scalpel Scroll Cut: Use an SVG icon of a scalpel. Use GSAP ScrollTrigger to pin the section. As you scroll, animate the height of a mask div or use clip-path to 'slice' the content.

Create an /admin route for the CMS. Mock the database interactions with a simple JSON state or Context API (using localStorage) so changes to texts and images actually persist locally during evaluation.
Make sure all content blocks (Hero Text, Philosophy Chapter texts, Gallery Photos, History Timeline, Videos) are editable via the CMS.
DO NOT use a fully transparent header. Use a blurred dark header (`bg-[#0E0B0A]/80 backdrop-blur-xl`) with a 1px solid bottom border (`border-[#2A1E19]`).
Apply 'data-testid' to all main elements, admin navigation links, and CMS save buttons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
Never apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Do not center align the App container globally. Respect natural reading flow.
Do not use AI emoji characters for icons. Use `lucide-react`.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Add subtle grain textures and custom cursors.
Always use the provided image URLs. NO generic placeholder links.
Implement Shadcn components customized to fit the premium mocha dark theme for the admin panel.
